text:
maria.chen: Heads up 11 We have a month-end problem: customer NimbusWorks (contract NW-2030-01) shows $54,120 of prepaid revenue recognized this month that should've been deferred. Looks like a billing run applied a promo+commit credit stack incorrectly across two months. Invoices: INV-2030-2120 and INV-2030-2121. Need guidance on revrec correction and whether to reverse accruals.

tom.hagen: Oof. Is this the promo stacking bug we fixed last quarter?

maria.chen: Similar symptom but different root. Promo id PROMO-NEW-23 was not excluded from commit-credit proration, so credits double-counted for the start month.

kevin.ng: Quick ask: what's the account GL impact? We need the GL lines to prepare a reversing JE and to update the deferred schedule.

maria.chen: Impact summary pasted below.
- Contract total prepaid: 120,000
- Recognized to date (should): 30,000
- Recognized in ledger (actual): 84,120
- Over-recognized: 54,120

maria.chen: SQL I ran to trace credit applications: ```sql
SELECT ac.invoice_id, ac.credit_id, ac.amount_applied, i.posted_date
FROM billing.applied_credits ac
JOIN billing.invoices i on ac.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE ac.contract_id = 'NW-2030-01'
ORDER BY i.posted_date;
```

billing-bot: billing-bot: RUN LOG: auto-apply job 1872499000 applied commit + promo credits to INV-2030-2120/2121. See job output: /var/log/billing/autoapply/1872499000.log

elaine.ops: Propose JE: debit Rev recognized (GL 4000) 54,120 credit Deferred revenue (GL 2005) 54,120. Draft memo: "Reversal of incorrectly recognized prepaid revenue due to double credit application (contract NW-2030-01)." @kevin.ng approve? Need entry posted before COB.

kevin.ng: Approve. Please include worksheet and link to billing run in the JE notes.

maria.chen: Uploaded worksheet: https://redwood-internal.s3/finance/NW-2030-01_revrec_workbook.xlsx

tom.hagen: I'll open a dev ticket to add a safeguard: when commit credit and promo credit both reference the same external coupon id, run should prefer commit proration. Creating ticket BE-4021.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-4021 - Credit stacking precedence check. Assigned tom.hagen.

cfo_lucas: For the close pack: include the JE number and a short note on ARR/NRR impact. Also, if this pattern hits other contracts, run a sweep query and estimate total exposure.

kevin.ng: I ran a quick sweep for contracts with both commit and promo credits applied same month; found 6 contracts with potential misapply totalling ~180k exposure. I'll schedule a deeper reconciliation and add an action item to the close notes.

maria.chen: Added line item to the month-end close pack and included the reversal JE reference. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
